continuity_scope: Onyx Path's Exalted Third Edition core rulebook, released in PDF and print on 20 April 2016, limited to the official release announcement, official Third Edition mechanics overview, official character-creation article, and official product-line index. This is the Solar-focused core product's rules/setting frame only. It does not merge Exalted first or second edition, Exalted: Essence, later Third Edition Exalt books, supplements, fiction, comics, games, community content, or home campaigns.

work_or_witnesses.edition: Core rulebook; official release announcement dated 20 April 2016.
Official rules-development overview; used for mechanics and Third Edition comparison boundaries.
Official worked player-character example; used only to identify core Solar/Caste/Charm terminology, not as a canonical character witness.
Official product index, last updated 1 December 2024; used for core-versus-supplement boundaries.

coverage_rule: Terms-only rules/setting audit. The selected official material explains a player-driven core game, its Solar character options, and a broad setting frame, but does not expose a bounded, claim-level corpus of named dramatic characters. No character or relationship records are made. Exalt types, castes, factions, gods and spirits, Charms, artifacts, Creation, cosmology, and rules remain terms/dimensions. Named figures may be added only through a separate exact official witness that profiles that individual; sample player characters and Storyteller-created characters are never canonically inferred.
omissions: All named Exalted, gods, spirits, rulers, Storyteller characters, and the illustrative player character Ayesha, because no selected witness is a bounded dramatic-character profile corpus.
All Exalt types other than the core product's Solar character option, as well as factions, castes, cults, Charms, artifacts, regions, Creation, cosmology, and mechanics as character nodes.
Earlier editions, Exalted: Essence, Dragon-Blooded, Lunars, Exigents, Sidereals, Abyssals, other supplements, fiction, comics, games, unofficial material, and campaign outcomes.
content_cautions: Official core framing includes combat, warfare, death, political domination, coercive social influence, and religious/cosmological imagery. These are fictional game subjects and should be handled with table-appropriate content boundaries.
The setting's imperial, cultural, and spiritual imagery is not a substitute for real-world history, living religion, or social identity.
uncertainties: The 2016 release announcement calls Third Edition a revitalized and expanded Creation and says its system redesign takes elements from earlier editions. This audit records no cross-edition identity, timeline, or retcon reconciliation.

Official material evidences a pre-publication/early-publication correction process for the advance PDF, but no dated, consolidated official core-rulebook errata document was found in this restricted witness set. No unverified errata is applied.
Official product pages distinguish Third Edition core and later books; later product availability does not backfill their rules, setting details, or named profiles into this core pass.
evidence_basis: Onyx Path official pages only. The release announcement establishes the exact Third Edition core product/date, Solar focus, Creation setting, and its relationship to earlier edition design; the mechanics overview identifies Third Edition procedures; the official worked example establishes selected terminology; and the product index distinguishes core material from subsequent product lines. The audit does not use fan wikis or infer facts from game play.
